title: Json Loader V1
features:
This turns a JSON into a list, to make more easy to make scripts that use json.

-NOTES-
Im still making this script, maybe have bugs.

It's Open Source, see the "HOW TO USE".

HOW TO USE:

-Commands-

JsonLoader.Load(URL needs to be .JSON)


CODE example:

--FIRST YOU NEED THIS.
local JsonLoader = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://zx-auth.onrender.com/files/APIs/jsonloader.lua"))()

--Second is this, to get a JSON from a site
local list = JsonLoader.Load("https://test-site/temp.json")

--And this
for i,v in ipairs(list) do
    print(i, v)
end
